note: Trained models (LoRAs and compositions) run on a base model. The plugin reads these base models' schemas to find which trained types each takes: modelTypes on their loras input (a LoRA) or their modelId input (a composition). The list says which models to read, never what they take. base_names maps compliantModelIds entries (base names, not model ids) to model ids; it only orders the candidates. default_scale is the LoRA weight when the trained model's record gives none of its own.
